text: DSH OpenAI subscription add-on 是面向 DSH Web 的模型提供方，通过本地适配器把 ChatGPT 订阅账户中的 OpenAI 模型接入模型菜单，并支持账户提供的推理强度选项。连接后可查看并刷新可用模型、发起文本对话、传递 DSH 函数工具调用，也可登录、查看连接状态或退出。它适合已在 macOS 上使用 DSH、希望通过 ChatGPT 订阅选择 OpenAI 模型的用户。需要 ChatGPT 账户并完成浏览器授权；运行需要 macOS、Node.js 22、DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1、pnpm 和 macOS Command Line Tools。

DSH OpenAI subscription add-on connects ChatGPT subscription models to DSH Web. It supports text, DSH tools, reasoning choices, and CLI login, model refresh, status, and logout. Requires a ChatGPT account, macOS, Node.js 22, DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1, pnpm, and macOS Command Line Tools.
想在 DSH 的模型菜单里使用自己 ChatGPT 订阅能访问的 OpenAI 模型。
让 DSH 能用 ChatGPT 账户里的模型，并支持选择推理强度。
How can I use models from my ChatGPT subscription in the DSH model picker?
DSH OpenAI subscription add-on 的功能「订阅模型接入」：将本地账户模型目录注册为 DSH 模型提供方，并根据模型元数据提供可选推理强度。用户连接账户后在 DSH 模型菜单选择模型。
DSH OpenAI subscription add-on 的功能「账户连接与模型管理」：命令行支持连接并授权 ChatGPT、重新登录、查看连接状态、刷新模型目录和退出；连接流程会把模型目录保存在本地状态目录。
DSH OpenAI subscription add-on 使用前须知：需要用浏览器授权 ChatGPT 账户访问订阅；本地连接和模型目录通过账户状态流程管理，模型使用量计入该 ChatGPT 计划。

dsh-openai-subscription README · DSH OpenAI subscription add-on：Install this small add-on after installing ordinary DeepSeek Harness. It adds OpenAI models and reasoning controls to DSH, using the official Sign in with ChatGPT subscription flow.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Connect：This first release supports **macOS**, Node.js 22+, macOS Command Line Tools, pnpm, and **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1**. It does not bundle another DSH runtime.

If DSH is not installed yet:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.1 pnpm
```

Install the shared package, then connect:

```sh
npm install -g pnpm https://github.com/teilomillet/dsh-openai-subscription/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-openai-subscription-0.1.0.tgz
```
```sh
dsh-openai connect
```
```sh
dsh web
```

dsh-openai-subscription README · Connect：The connection command installs the provider into DSH's existing **web** profile and opens official browser sign-in. Allow the app to use your ChatGPT plan. In DSH, select a workspace, open the model menu, and choose **OpenAI subscription (ChatGPT)**. The **Effort** submenu exposes the documented options for that model. Restart DSH after connecting if it was already running.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Connect：Your other DSH providers, model selection, tools, and sessions remain intact. Usage counts against your ChatGPT plan. This add-on uses text and function tools; image input and native OpenAI hosted tools are not implemented.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Connect：The account model list can omit GPT-6.1 Sol. Connection makes at most one 60-second low-effort check for an omitted, previously unverified GPT-6.1 Sol, and adds it locally only after completed inference. That check uses a small amount of your plan allowance. Other reasoning levels come from official model capability documentation. Failed verification leaves the discovered models available. Reconnecting a verified profile avoids another access check.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Share or install through Git：Share the **.tgz file**, or commit this package's source with its .gitignore. No login credentials or account-specific model state belong in the repository.

To build a package from source:

```sh
npm ci
npm pack
```

The pack step builds the vendored SDK automatically. Send the generated tarball to the other computer and run the connection commands there. Each person signs in with their own account.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Commands：```sh
dsh-openai connect                 # install web provider and sign in
dsh-openai connect --profile headless
dsh-openai login                   # reconnect without reinstalling
dsh-openai status

Without a global add-on installation, DSH's native plugin commands work too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-openai-subscription-0.1.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-openai login
dsh web
```

dsh-openai-subscription README · Commands：To remove the provider from a profile, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-openai-subscription`. Run logout first if you also want to disconnect the subscription.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Local state and security：Authentication, model discovery, and the Keychain helper are stored under `$DSH_HOME/openai-subscription/` (normally `~/.dsh/openai-subscription/`). `DSH_OPENAI_HOME` can select a separate state directory. OAuth state is encrypted with a key stored in macOS Keychain; credentials are not copied from Codex. The package and generated tarball exclude all account state, sessions, model overrides, caches, and installed dependencies. Browser consent remains an explicit user action.

dsh-openai-subscription README · Local state and security：Windows and Linux are not supported by this release. The macOS helper needs Command Line Tools to compile on first use; install them using `xcode-select --install` if needed.
